content: We benchmark single-task fine-tuning configurations using CommonsenseQA BIBREF8 and SocialIQA BIBREF7. On CommonsenseQA with $\mathrm {RoBERTa}_\mathrm {LARGE}$, jiant achieves an accuracy of 0.722, comparable to 0.721 reported by BIBREF27. On SocialIQA with BERT-large, jiant achieves a dev set accuracy of 0.658, comparable to 0.66 reported in BIBREF7.
